name: Astral Deva (Angel)
description: Medium outsider (angel, extraplanar, good) with 12 RHD. Celestial warrior with wings of flight, DR 10/evil, SR 30, and change shape. LA +8.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: Astral devas can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: Can see twice as far as a human in dim illumination, retaining color and detail.

ability.name: Resistance to Electricity 10
ability.description: Ignore the first 10 points of electricity damage per attack.

ability.name: Resistance to Fire 10
ability.description: Ignore the first 10 points of fire damage per attack.

ability.name: Protective Aura (Su)
ability.description: 20 ft. aura grants allies +4 deflection AC and +4 resistance saves against attacks made or effects created by evil creatures. Functions as magic circle against evil and lesser globe of invulnerability.

ability.name: Tongues (Su)
ability.description: Speak with any creature with a language, as the tongues spell (caster level 12th). Always active.

ability.name: Uncanny Dodge (Ex)
ability.description: Retains Dexterity bonus to AC when flat-footed. Cannot be flanked except by a rogue of 16th+ level. Can flank characters with uncanny dodge as a 12th-level rogue.

ability.name: Change Shape (Su)
ability.description: Assume the form of any Small or Medium humanoid.

ability.name: Stun (Su)
ability.description: If the deva strikes a foe twice in one round with its mace, that creature must succeed on a DC 22 Fortitude save or be stunned for 1d6 rounds.

ability.name: Good-Aligned Strikes
ability.description: Natural weapons and wielded weapons are treated as good-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

name: Hound Archon
description: Medium outsider (archon, lawful, good, extraplanar) with 6 RHD. Canine-headed celestial with scent, teleport, and change shape to any canine. LA +5.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Aura of Menace (Su)
ability.description: 20 ft. aura: hostile creatures must succeed on Will DC 16 or take -2 penalty on attacks, AC, and saves for 24 hours (or until they successfully hit the archon).

ability.name: Magic Circle Against Evil (Su)
ability.description: Continuous effect as the spell (caster level 6th). Can be dispelled but reactivated as a free action.

ability.name: Scent
ability.description: Detect opponents by scent within 30 ft. (60 ft. upwind, 15 ft. downwind).

ability.name: Teleport (Su)
ability.description: At will, as greater teleport (self + 50 lbs of objects only, caster level 14th).

ability.name: Tongues (Su)
ability.description: Speak with any creature with a language, as the tongues spell (caster level 14th). Always active.

ability.name: Change Shape (Su)
ability.description: Assume any canine form of Small to Large size. Loses bite/slam/greatsword attacks but gains the bite of the chosen form. +4 circumstance on Hide and Survival checks in canine form.

ability.name: Good- and Lawful-Aligned Strikes
ability.description: Natural weapons and wielded weapons are treated as good- and lawful-aligned for DR purposes.

name: Trumpet Archon
description: Medium outsider (archon, lawful, good, extraplanar) with 12 RHD. Silver-trumpet-wielding archon, casts as 14th-level cleric, DR 10/evil, SR 29. LA +8.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Aura of Menace (Su)
ability.description: 20 ft. aura: hostile creatures must succeed on Will DC 21 or take -2 penalty on attacks, AC, and saves for 24 hours.

ability.name: Magic Circle Against Evil (Su)
ability.description: Continuous effect as the spell (caster level 14th).

ability.name: Teleport (Su)
ability.description: At will, as greater teleport (self + 50 lbs of objects only, caster level 14th).

ability.name: Tongues (Su)
ability.description: Speak with any creature with a language, as the tongues spell (caster level 14th). Always active.

ability.name: Trumpet (Su)
ability.description: Instrument produces music of piercing beauty and, if willed, paralyzing awe. All non-archons within 100 ft. must succeed on Fortitude DC 19 or be paralyzed 1d4 rounds. Can command trumpet to become a +4 greatsword as a free action.

ability.name: Divine Spellcasting (14th-Level Cleric)
ability.description: Casts divine spells as a 14th-level cleric. Access to two domains from: Air, Destruction, Good, Law, War (plus deity's). Save DCs Wisdom-based.

ability.name: Good- and Lawful-Aligned Strikes
ability.description: Natural weapons and wielded weapons are treated as good- and lawful-aligned for DR purposes.

name: Djinni
description: Large outsider (air, extraplanar) with 7 RHD. Aristocratic genie of the Plane of Air with flight, whirlwind form, and classic genie spell-like abilities. LA +6.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Plane Shift (Sp)
ability.description: Enter any of the elemental planes, the Astral Plane, or the Material Plane (self + up to 8 linked-hand creatures). As the plane shift spell, caster level 13th.

ability.name: Telepathy 100 ft.
ability.description: Communicate telepathically with any creature within 100 ft. that has a language.

ability.name: Air Mastery (Ex)
ability.description: Airborne creatures take -1 penalty on attack and damage rolls against a djinni.

ability.name: Whirlwind (Su)
ability.description: Once every 10 minutes, transform into a whirlwind (5 ft. base, up to 30 ft. top, up to 50 ft. tall) for up to 7 rounds. Creatures one size smaller may be caught (DC 20 Reflex save), taking 3d6 damage and potentially held aloft (1d8/round). Charisma-based save includes +3 racial.

name: Azer
description: Medium outsider (fire, extraplanar) with 2 RHD. Dwarflike fire-plane natives with intense body heat, fire immunity, and cold vulnerability. LA +4.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Vulnerability to Cold
ability.description: Takes half again as much (+50%) damage from cold.

ability.name: Heat (Ex)
ability.description: Body is intensely hot; unarmed attacks deal +1 fire damage, and metallic weapons wielded also conduct this heat.

name: Grig (Sprite)
description: Tiny fey with 1/2 RHD. Cricket-like faerie with leaping prowess, fiddle music, and DR 5/cold iron. LA +3.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: See twice as far as a human in dim illumination.

ability.name: Fiddle (Su)
ability.description: One grig per band carries a tiny fiddle. Non-sprites within 30 ft. must succeed on Will DC 12 or be affected as by irresistible dance while the fiddle plays.

ability.name: Forest Move Silently
ability.description: +5 additional racial bonus on Move Silently checks in a forest setting.

name: Nixie (Sprite)
description: Small aquatic fey with 1 RHD. Lake-dwelling charmer with DR 5/cold iron, water breathing, and wild empathy. LA +3.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: See twice as far as a human in dim illumination.

ability.name: Amphibious (Ex)
ability.description: Although nixies are aquatic, they can survive indefinitely on land.

ability.name: Water Concealment
ability.description: +5 racial bonus on Hide checks when in water.

ability.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
ability.description: As the druid class feature with +6 racial bonus on the check.

name: Gnoll
description: Medium humanoid (gnoll) with 2 RHD. Hyena-headed savage with darkvision and simple combat instincts. LA +1.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: Gnolls can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Goblin
description: Small humanoid (goblinoid) with 1 RHD (treated as class level). Small wicked scavenger with darkvision and skilled ambush tactics. LA +0.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: Goblins can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Sahuagin
description: Medium monstrous humanoid (aquatic) with 2 RHD. Predatory shark-fish folk with swim 60, blindsense, blood frenzy, and rake. LA +2.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Blindsense 30 ft. (Underwater)
ability.description: Can locate creatures underwater within 30 ft. Works only while submerged.

ability.name: Blood Frenzy (Ex)
ability.description: Once per day, when taking damage in combat, the sahuagin may enter a frenzy next round: +2 Constitution, +2 Strength, -2 AC, and attacks madly until it or its opponent is dead. Cannot voluntarily end the frenzy.

ability.name: Rake (Ex)
ability.description: Two additional rake attacks (+2 melee, 1d4+1) when attacking while swimming.

ability.name: Freshwater Sensitivity (Ex)
ability.description: Fully immersed in fresh water, must succeed on Fortitude DC 15 or become fatigued. Repeats every 10 minutes.

ability.name: Light Blindness (Ex)
ability.description: Abrupt exposure to bright light blinds a sahuagin for 1 round. On subsequent rounds, dazzled while in bright light.

ability.name: Speak with Sharks (Ex)
ability.description: Telepathically communicate simple concepts with sharks up to 150 ft. away.

ability.name: Water Dependent (Ex)
ability.description: Can survive out of water for 1 hour per 2 points of Constitution.

name: Fire Giant
description: Large giant (fire) with 15 RHD. Volcano-dwelling giant with fire immunity, cold vulnerability, and heated-rock throwing. LA +4.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: See twice as far as a human in dim illumination.

ability.name: Vulnerability to Cold
ability.description: Takes half again as much (+50%) damage from cold.

ability.name: Rock Throwing (Ex)
ability.description: Range increment 120 ft. Can heat rocks in fire/lava to deal extra fire damage.

ability.name: Rock Catching (Ex)
ability.description: Can catch Small, Medium, or Large thrown rocks with a successful Reflex save (DC 15, 20, or 25 respectively).

name: Frost Giant
description: Large giant (cold) with 14 RHD. Arctic giant with cold immunity, fire vulnerability, and rock-throwing tactics. LA +4.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: See twice as far as a human in dim illumination.

ability.name: Vulnerability to Fire
ability.description: Takes half again as much (+50%) damage from fire.

ability.name: Rock Throwing (Ex)
ability.description: Range increment 120 ft.

ability.name: Rock Catching (Ex)
ability.description: Can catch Small, Medium, or Large thrown rocks with a successful Reflex save.

name: Hill Giant
description: Large giant with 12 RHD. Brutish highland giant with low-light vision and rock-throwing tactics. LA +4.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: See twice as far as a human in dim illumination.

ability.name: Rock Throwing (Ex)
ability.description: Range increment 120 ft.

ability.name: Rock Catching (Ex)
ability.description: Can catch Small, Medium, or Large thrown rocks with a successful Reflex save.

ability.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
ability.description: Automatically proficient with simple and martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields.

name: Stone Giant
description: Large giant (earth) with 14 RHD. Reclusive mountain-dwelling giant with darkvision, low-light vision, and stone-camouflage Hide. LA +4 (elder +6).

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: See twice as far as a human in dim illumination.

ability.name: Rock Throwing (Ex)
ability.description: Range increment 180 ft. Uses both hands to throw.

ability.name: Rock Catching (Ex)
ability.description: +4 racial bonus on Reflex save to catch thrown rocks.

ability.name: Rocky Terrain Camouflage
ability.description: +8 racial bonus on Hide checks in rocky terrain.

name: Athach
description: Huge aberration with 14 RHD. Hulking three-armed giant with a poisonous bite and multi-weapon strikes. LA +5.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Three Arms
ability.description: An athach has three arms and can wield three weapons (primary + two off-hand) with Multiweapon Fighting.

ability.name: Poison Bite (Ex)
ability.description: Injury poison on bite: Fort DC 19 (Con-based), initial 1d6 Str, secondary 2d6 Str.

name: Skum
description: Medium aquatic aberration with 2 RHD. Frog-fish slave-race of aboleths with amphibious nature, rake, and strong swim. LA +3.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Amphibious (Ex)
ability.description: Can breathe air and water equally; may live indefinitely in either environment.

ability.name: Rake (Ex)
ability.description: Two additional rake attacks (1d6+2) when attacking while swimming.

ability.name: Underwater Senses
ability.description: +4 racial bonus on Hide, Listen, and Spot checks underwater.

name: Shambling Mound
description: Large plant with 8 RHD. Intelligent carnivorous vegetable mass; immune to electricity (gains Con when shocked), resist fire 10, plant immunities. LA +6.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: See in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: See twice as far as a human in dim illumination.

ability.name: Electrical Invigoration (Ex)
ability.description: Instead of taking electricity damage, gains 1d4 temporary Con (loses 1 per hour).

ability.name: Resistance to Fire 10
ability.description: Ignore the first 10 points of fire damage per attack.

ability.name: Plant Traits
ability.description: Immune to mind-affecting effects (charms, compulsions, phantasms, patterns, morale), poison, sleep, paralysis, polymorph, and stunning. Not subject to critical hits.

ability.name: Improved Grab (Ex)
ability.description: When the shambler hits with both slam attacks, it may attempt a grapple as a free action without provoking AoOs.

ability.name: Constrict (Ex)
ability.description: Deals 2d6+7 bludgeoning damage on a successful grapple check.

ability.name: Swamp/Forest Camouflage
ability.description: +12 additional racial bonus on Hide checks when in swampy or forested areas (stacks to +16 total).
